Card Q&A.a: Yes. This card moving to your trash will cause you to have 7 Digimon cards with [Devimon] in their names in your trash. As such, you will be able to activate this card's [On Deletion] effect to play a [DanDevimon] from your trash.
Card Q&A.q: I have 6 cards with [Devimon] in their names in my trash. If a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is deleted, can I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to play a [DanDevimon] from my trash without paying its memory cost?

Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] If you have 7 or more Digimon cards with [Devimon] in their names in your trash, you may play 1 [DanDevimon] from your trash without paying its memory cost.
